parsed.change_summary: Added a check to ensure that the index 'i' does not exceed the 'bytes' parameter before accessing 'data[i]'.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the added check ensures that the index 'i' does not exceed the 'bytes' parameter before accessing 'data[i]'. This prevents accessing out-of-bounds memory, which would have caused a buffer overflow.
